     3|*Mission AI: "Your grandparents watched Earth's power levels like a lifeline. You watch Earth's power levels as a curiosity."*  
     4|*Dr. Arun Patel III: "We don't just consume power anymore. We converse with it."*

     6|The alert came not as a crisis warning, but as a ceremonial notification: Grid Synchronization Milestone Achieved - Martian-Isolated Operation for 72 Consecutive Hours. Arun Patel III adjusted his glasses, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent watching electrons dance through Martian conductors, as he looked at the notification flashing across his console in the Valles Marineris Power Authority's central chamber.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," he said, his voice carrying the rasp of years spent in utility tunnels and the quiet pride of generational expertise, "confirm the nature of this milestone."
